description: Validate a Belgian legal citation against the database — zero-hallucination check. Parses the citation, checks that the document and provision exist, and returns warnings about status (repealed, amended). Use this to verify any citation BEFORE including it in a legal analysis. Supports formats: "Loi du 2 février 1994, art. 1", "Section 3, Data Protection Act 2018", or statute ID + provision reference.

citation.description: Citation string to validate. Examples: "Loi du 2 février 1994, art. 1", "loi-2018-07-30-2018040581-fr art3".

name: validate_citation
